items.title: 5.4.4 Pani ki khusoosiyat par hydrogen bonding ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.4, printed pages 102-103, with Quick Check 5.4 and answers.

blocks.text: i. Barf ki banawat (structure) aur kam density

Pani ke molecule ki shakal tetrahedral hai: oxygen ke do lone pairs tetrahedron ke do konon (corners) par hote hain. Jab pani ka temperature kam ho kar barf banti hai to molecules zyada ba-qaida (regular) tarteeb mein aa jate hain aur yeh tarteeb poori banawat mein phail jati hai. Is hydrogen-bonded jaal mein khali jagahen ban jati hain (Figure 5.6). Isi liye jamne par pani 9% zyada jagah gherta hai aur us ki density kam ho jati hai, aur barf pani par tairti hai. Barf ke is anokhe (anomalous) rawaiye ki wajah se machhliyan aur doosre jandar jami hui jheelon aur samandaron ke neeche zinda rehte hain: kam density wali barf ki chadar pani ki satah dhanp leti hai aur neeche wala pani bahar ki thand se bacha (insulated) rehta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Pani ke do molecules gend aur dandi (ball and stick) ki shakal mein: baen molecule ka O (2δ-) dashed hydrogen bond se daen molecule ke H (δ+) se juda. Naap: O se O 2.8 A; hydrogen bond par O se H 1.8 A; covalent O-H 1.0 A. (b) Barf ki do tah-ba-tah (stacked) chhe-kona (hexagonal) tahein: har surkh O ke do chhote thos covalent bonds safed H atoms se, aur dashed hydrogen bonds H ko padosi O se jorte hain; beech mein khuli chhe-kona jagahen.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Barf mein wasee hydrogen bonding aur molecules ke darmiyan khali jagahen (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein ek H do oxygen atoms ke darmiyan hai: apne O se covalent bond (1.0 Å, chhota aur mazboot) aur doosre O se hydrogen bond (1.8 Å, lamba aur kamzor). (b) mein har O ke saath do H covalent bonds se jure hain aur dashed hydrogen bonds molecules ko ek khule chhe-kona (hexagonal) jaal mein jorte hain. Beech ki khali jagahon ki wajah se barf pani se 9% zyada jagah leti hai aur us ki density kam hoti hai, is liye barf tairti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.6 (a) mein daen wale oxygen par charge ka label do baar chhapa hai (‘2δ’ aur ‘2δ−’). Sahi ek hi label 2δ− hai, jaisa upar diagram mein hai.
Pani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai, yani use garam karne ke liye zyada heat chahiye. Wajah us ki khas molecular banawat hai jo mazboot hydrogen bonds banne deti hai.
iii. Heat of vaporization aur boiling point ka anokha rawaiya

Group 16 ke hydrides mein enthalpy change of vaporization (liquid ko vapour banane ki heat) aam taur par H₂S se H₂Po tak barhti jati hai (Figure 5.7), kyunke in molecules ko kamzor London dispersion forces jore rakhti hain.

blocks.alt: H2O, H2S, H2Se, H2Te aur H2Po ke liye element ke atomic number ke muqable mein do line graphs. Oopar enthalpy of vaporization (10 se 50 kJ/mol): H2O taqreeban 41, H2S par gir kar taqreeban 18, phir H2Se taqreeban 20 aur H2Te taqreeban 24 se H2Po taqreeban 38 tak. Neeche boiling point (-90 se 110 degrees C): H2O 100, H2S taqreeban -60, H2Se taqreeban -41, H2Te taqreeban -2, H2Po taqreeban 35.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Group 16 hydrides ki enthalpy of vaporization aur boiling points ka graph (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein H₂S se H₂Po tak line upar jati hai, kyunke molecule bara hone se London forces barhti hain. Is hisab se H₂O sab se neeche hona chahiye tha, magar woh sab se upar hai (100 °C aur taqreeban 41 kJ mol⁻¹). Wajah pani ke molecules ke darmiyan mazboot hydrogen bonds hain. Kitab ke pehle graph ke unwan (title) mein ‘of 16 hydrides’ chhapa hai; sahi ‘group 16 hydrides’ hai.

Group mein neeche S se Po tak atomic size barhta hai, is liye van der Waals forces bhi mazboot hoti jati hain. Agar pani isi trend par chalta to us ki heat of vaporization group mein sab se kam hoti. Lekin pani ki enthalpy change of vaporization group mein sab se zyada hai (41 kJ mol⁻¹). Wajah: pani bohat zyada hydrogen bonded hai, is liye us ke molecules ke darmiyan forces torna aur use vapour banana mushkil hai. Pani ka boiling point bhi group 16 ke baqi hydrides se kahin zyada hai: molecules ko alag karne ke liye bohat energy chahiye, aur itni energy dene ke liye ooncha temperature chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab unit “kJ mol⁻” chhapti hai; sahi unit kJ mol⁻¹ hai (41 kJ mol⁻¹).

Pani ki surface tension aur viscosity bhi bohat zyada hain. Surface tension satah (surface) ke molecules par neeche ki taraf khinchao hai, jis se pani ki satah tani hui (stretched) rehti hai. Yeh khinchao andar ke molecules hydrogen bonds ke zariye lagate hain.

Viscosity liquid ka behne (flow) ke khilaf rukawat (resistance) hai. Pani ki viscosity bohat se liquids se zyada hai, jaise chhote hydrocarbons aur alcohols (maslan hexane aur ethanol). Wajah phir mazboot hydrogen bonds hain. Alcohols bhi hydrogen bond banate hain, magar pani se bohat kam aur kamzor; hydrocarbons hydrogen bond bana hi nahi sakte.

blocks.prompt: a) Kya CHF₃ hydrogen bond bana sakta hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: CHF₃ ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bond nahi banate, kyunke us ka H carbon se jura hai, F, O ya N se nahi; is liye H par kaafi δ+ charge nahi aata. (Us ke F atoms kisi doosre molecule, jaise pani, ke H se bond le sakte hain.)

blocks.prompt: b) Ethanol ke do molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bond dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: Ek ethanol molecule ka O−H wala H (δ+) doosre molecule ke O (δ−) ke lone pair ki taraf khinchta hai: CH₃CH₂−O−H ··· O(H)−CH₂CH₃. Dotted line hydrogen bond hai.

blocks.prompt: c) CH₃CH₂CH₃, CH₃CH₂OH aur CH₃CH₂Cl mein kaun si forces hain? Boiling point ki barhti tarteeb batayein.
blocks.explanation: Propane (CH₃CH₂CH₃): sirf London forces. Chloroethane (CH₃CH₂Cl): London + dipole-dipole forces. Ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH): London + dipole-dipole + hydrogen bonding. Tarteeb: CH₃CH₂CH₃ < CH₃CH₂Cl < CH₃CH₂OH.

blocks.prompt: d, e) Ethane (-89 ℃) aur methanol (65 ℃) ka farq 154 ℃ hai, magar butane (0 ℃) aur propanol (97 ℃) ka farq sirf 97 ℃. Molecule bara hone par farq kyun kam hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono pairs mein alcohol ka zyada boiling point us ke O−H group ke hydrogen bond se aata hai, jo har pair mein taqreeban utna hi hai. Lekin molecule bara hone se London forces barh jati hain aur kul kashish ka bara hissa ban jati hain, is liye hydrogen bond ka izafi asar nisbatan chhota reh jata hai aur farq ghat jata hai. (Kitab mein butane ka formula CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₄ chhapa hai; sahi CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ hai.)

blocks.prompt: f) Khalis (pure) acetic acid dimers ki shakal mein kyun hota hai magar pani mein ghol (aqueous solution) mein nahi?
blocks.explanation: Khalis acetic acid mein do molecules apne COOH groups ke darmiyan do hydrogen bonds bana kar jora (dimer) ban jate hain. Pani mein acid ke O−H aur C=O groups aas paas ke bohat se pani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds bana lete hain, is liye dimer toot jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 5.4 d) ii mein kitab butane ko “CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₄” likhti hai; aisa formula mumkin nahi (aakhri carbon ke paanch bond ho jate). Sahi CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ hai.

items: Barf: khali jagahon wala ba-qaida hydrogen-bonded jaal, 9% zyada volume, kam density, pani par tairti hai aur neeche ka pani bachati hai.
Pani ki specific heat capacity, heat of vaporization (41 kJ mol⁻¹), boiling point, surface tension aur viscosity sab zyada hain, wajah wasee (extensive) hydrogen bonding.
